children: Catcher Predict monitoring showed the Polymarket submarket for the Bitcoin August 29 breakout event, the "78,000" "yes" option, rose sharply from 6.5% one hour earlier to 27.5% at present, a 21 percentage point increase. According to ChainCatcher, the move suggests traders are reacting to a possible breaking news catalyst.

title: Polymarket Bitcoin August 29 Breakout Bet Jumps to 27.5%
